facts.value: Qualifying Test for elective module courses (English, French, Spanish) is an online test consisting of multiple-choice questions that assesses knowledge in grammar, vocabulary (especially in the field of economics), and text comprehension.
B2.2 level is required to pass the Qualifying Test.
The Qualifying Test is offered every semester before the start of lectures.
Participation in the Qualifying Test can be waived with certain language certificates.

Waivers for the English Qualifying Test can be obtained with the following: Cambridge English C1 Certificate, TOEFL Test of at least 100 points, IELTS test of 7.5 points or higher, language certificate C1 from a Bachelor's WPM in business English from previous semesters.

Waivers for the French Qualifying Test can be obtained with the following: Baccalauréat, Abibac, DALF/DELF C1, language certificate C1 from a Bachelor's WPM in business French from previous semesters.
Waivers for the Spanish Qualifying Test can be obtained with the following: language certificate C1 from a Bachelor's WPM in business Spanish from previous semesters.
You must enroll with your student ID to start the Qualifying Test.
You can upload your existing language certificates only within the specified time windows. Language certificates will not be accepted outside of this platform.
The Qualifying Test is only open during the specified time windows. There is no second date.
Online Qualifying Test English on September 28, 2026, from 9 AM to 11 AM.
Online Qualifying Test French on September 28, 2026, from 12 PM to 2 PM.
Online Qualifying Test Spanish on September 28, 2026, from 3 PM to 5 PM.
